excluded.reason: committed evidence documents are data, not code, and are validated by the deterministic gates that produced them; the harnesses that generate them are review-relevant and matched above
prose and acceptance data outside docs/adr; reviewed by people and by deterministic gates, not by the model

binary assets carry no reviewable source. SVG is deliberately NOT here: it is text and can carry <script>, so it is review-relevant above. Property lists likewise — a macOS entitlements plist is a privilege boundary.

remaining prose, data, and configuration not named as review-relevant above; covered by deterministic gates. HTML is deliberately NOT here: 27 design-system pages carry inline <script>, so HTML is review-relevant above.

package-level tooling ignore and editor files. Three things are deliberately NOT here. The ROOT .gitignore: its entries protect .keiko/ audit evidence and /only-for-internal-use/, and no deterministic gate pins them. .gitattributes: it can mark sources binary and hide them from review. The Prettier controls: they steer a required gate's own verdict. Also LAST rather than a catch-all, so an unmatched path reaches inventory.unclassified_path and fails the run.

contractPairs.contract: Figma Snapshot BFF response interfaces must stay structurally identical to the UI's independently declared fetch types
Files-browser interfaces re-declared in the route file must stay structurally identical to the published bff-wire contract
Bounded terminal-execution (ADR-0018) interfaces re-declared in the route file must stay structurally identical to the published bff-wire contract
The credential-free SafeGatewayConfig/SafeProviderConfig projection must stay structurally identical to the published bff-wire contract the UI imports
GitBranchListEntry/GitBranchListResponse emitted by the git routes must stay structurally identical to the UI's independently declared fetch types
ActiveWorkspaceView must stay structurally identical to the UI's independently declared copy
Every EvidenceBrowserEventType string literal must appear in the UI's ALL_SSE_EVENT_TYPES dispatch table

pathInstructions.instructions: This file is a SHRINKING baseline of hardcoded UI literals awaiting i18n extraction. Entries being removed is the desired direction: it means those strings moved into i18n message resources. Before reporting a removal as a defect, check whether this same change moves the strings into i18n resource files or removes the component; report only when the literals genuinely disappear from both sides. Growth of this baseline, not shrinkage, is the suspicious direction.
